name: Heroes Battlegrounds
creator: more awesome games yo
redeem: Launch Heroes Battlegrounds on Roblox and load into the map.
Open the chat window with the chat icon in the top-left corner.
Type !code, then a space, then the code. For example: !code WELOVEDELAYSITHINK
Press Enter to send it and the reward is added to your account.
notes:
Heroes Battlegrounds is a fighting game from the group more awesome games yo, based on superhero anime. You pick a hero or villain, each with their own set of moves and an ultimate, then drop into a shared map to punch, dash and combo other players. Fighting bosses and playing a character raises its mastery, which unlocks a stronger mastered version of that fighter.

Codes here give either free emotes or mastery progress. Mastery progress is the better reward, because it speeds up unlocking a mastered character, while emotes are just for fun. New codes usually drop when a new mastered character comes out, after maintenance or delays, and around holidays. The developers post them in the Discord and on the Trello board.

faq.q: Where do I type Heroes Battlegrounds codes?
faq.a: There is no code box. Type the code into the Roblox chat with !code in front of it, like !code WELOVEDELAYSITHINK, then press Enter.

faq.q: Why did my code not work in chat?
faq.a: Check that there is a space after !code and that the code is in capital letters. Older codes like AZUREMASTERYULT and LOVESICKKILLERULT have been reported as expired.
It fills a character's mastery bar, and a full bar unlocks the mastered version of that character with stronger moves. EXPLOSIONHEROMASTERYRELEASE gives 5 progress.

tips: Learn the basic keys before big fights: F blocks, Q dashes and G uses your ultimate. Pressing Q while ragdolled gives a recovery dash that can pull you out of a combo.
Jumping and then left clicking does a downslam. Mix it in with normal punches so other players have a harder time guessing your next move.
Pick one hero or villain you enjoy and stick with them for a while. Mastery builds up on that character, so jumping between fighters every match spreads your progress thin.
Hold your ultimate until an enemy is low or caught in your combo. Firing it at a player who can still block or dash away often wastes it.
useRewards: Redeem EXPLOSIONHEROMASTERYRELEASE first, since its 5 Mastery Progress pushes you toward a stronger mastered fighter. The other three codes give emotes, which are just for fun, so there is nothing to save. Claim all four in one go, because codes here have a habit of expiring when the next mastered character arrives, like LOVESICKKILLERULT did. Press B afterwards to open the emote menu and try your new ones out.
